title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: enrollment activation and proof-of-employment basis
content:
The Corporate Wellness Partnership requires that a corporate wellness enrollment be activated only after proof of employment matching one of the tier's accepted proof types has been provided, and only within the tier's grace period counted from the date the application was made. The enrollment record itself, once its lifecycle status shows active, stands as the system evidence that this employment verification was completed; there is no separate verification record apart from the enrollment's own status.

Stated as condition and action: where proof of employment matching an accepted type for the tier has been provided within the tier's grace period of the application, the enrollment may be activated; where it has not, activation is not authorized.

The accepted proof types and the length of the grace period both vary by partnership tier and are stated in a separate document; this document states only the activation basis itself — that a qualifying proof, given inside the applicable grace period, is what authorizes moving the enrollment's lifecycle status to active, and that the active status thereafter serves as the record of that verification having occurred.
